subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should this issue remain the canonical design thread for detached longwork final-delivery ownership, and should the permanent contract be explicit owner modes or a narrower extension of existing requester/completionOwnerKey routing?
rationale: The source gap is real, but choosing the public model-facing/plugin-facing contract and compatibility defaults cannot be safely automated after the previous broad PR closed unmerged.

options.title: Keep this as the canonical design thread
options.body: Use this issue to choose the owner-mode contract and require the next PR to be narrow, documented, and proven against a real channel path.

options.title: Narrow to existing requester-key routing
options.body: Treat completionOwnerKey plus durable pending-final delivery as the preferred substrate and ask for a smaller issue/PR focused on the missing invariant only.

options.title: Split by channel/runtime symptom
options.body: Move concrete Slack, Discord, plugin-runtime, and background-work failures to narrower issues if maintainers do not want a shared core ownership contract yet.

recommendation.title: Keep this as the canonical design thread
recommendation.body: Use this issue to choose the owner-mode contract and require the next PR to be narrow, documented, and proven against a real channel path.
